privacy.title: Privacy

master.label: Public profile
master.description: Anyone with the link can see your profile. Off by default.

stats.label: Statistics
stats.description: Shows only your total sessions and your favorite device.

reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.description: Shows your device reviews on your public profile.

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: Shows the devices you use and how many sessions each has.

privacy.neverShow: Grams and hours are never shown publicly.
privacy.publicSessionsNote: Sessions you publish from your diary are always visible while your profile is public.

export.description: Download everything we store about you — profile, sessions and reviews — as JSON.

email.label: Stored Google email
email.description: We keep {{email}} to re-link your account when you sign in with Google. Deleting it doesn't affect your sign-ins.
email.error: Couldn't delete the email — try again.

delete.label: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently deletes your account, your sessions and your reviews. There is no way back.
delete.confirmBody: This permanently deletes your account, every session and every review. It can't be undone. If you want a copy first, export your data.
delete.error: Couldn't delete your account — try again.

private.title: This profile is private or doesn't exist
